title: Postcodes for Laravel: GB Postcode Lookup and Geography Data
content:
Postcodes for Laravel adds typed GB postcode lookups, validation, geography data, distance searches, and test fakes through the GB Postcodes API.

The post Postcodes for Laravel: GB Postcode Lookup and Geography Data appeared first on Laravel News.
